text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I had come to check out an event
co-sponsored by the academy and Bubbly Land,
when...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Nakayama-senpai?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El would really like to know what on earth
you brought me all the way here for~...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El.
Do you know what's happening here today?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, the "Horse Girl Water Gun Tournament"?
Don't tell me we're participating in that, desuよね...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. *I'm* not entering.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A while back, you said
you wanted to do a tandem run with me, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! I did say that, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then win this tournament.
If you do, I'll take you on.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿¡Qué?! What does that have to do withーー

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not asking about that.
Are you in, or are you out? Which is it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
On one condition! When I win,
you definitely have to run with me this time desu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh, a deal's a deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, El Condor Pasa entered
the "Horse Girl Water Gun Tournament"ーー

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Toryaaaーー!! No one can escape
El's aerial acrobatics deeeeesu!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh!! Participant El Condor Pasa
takes down three opponents in a rowーー!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, El won't run or hide!
Bring on all challengers desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter who steps up, El will not lose!
Because losing is simply not an option desu!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah. Those eyes...
Those are the eyes I wanted to see...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(All that's left is to see how far
that genuine drive takes her...)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Total victory! Splendid win! El is champion!!
I did itーー! El won desu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...No need to shout so loud.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I could tell how it'd turn out
just from looking at your eyes during the match.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, why can't you bring
that kind of passion to your training, you damn fool?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Utter regret, complete dismay, El has been eliminated.
Even though I made it all the way to the finals...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I accept this result desu!
This is El's true strength! Nothing left but to train harder desu!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, why can't you bring
that kind of passion to your training, you damn fool?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Back then, you didn't have that feeling of
"I want to beat the opponent in front of me no matter what", right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I'm serious, I run with fast people!
I rethink my training! I do so much every single day desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All so I can measure up on the world stage!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's... you're right...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was so worried about whether I'd cut it overseas...
that instead of winning, all I focused on
was trying to convince myself...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow after school.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ? What about tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A tandem run. What, don't want to?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-Of course I do desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This time I'm coming at you with everything to win,
so you'd better brace yourself desu!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Finally... Looks like we'll have a match that puts us on edge!!
